candidate_program.name: bounded_weighted_overlap_margin
candidate_program.rationale: Uses minimum-weight overlap among active rivals to discount displaced reward, with the strongest rival retained as a floor. The signed margin only moderately adjusts reward per conflict; local weighted edge enumeration can be quadratic in degree.
candidate_program.rule: weight / (1 + degree) * (1 + 0.2 * (weight - max(max_conflict_weight, conflict_weight / (1 + max(0, weighted_redundancy)))) / (1 + weight + conflict_weight))

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
